request: Convert the architect's numbering to our PART / 1.1 / A. / 1. / a. scheme from the example file
summary: Every paragraph numbered by the document's main list gets the matching level style of the example file (PRT, ART, PR1, PR2, PR3 — imported with their list when the file lacks them) and loses its own list numbering, so the scheme's list numbers it; every paragraph's new number is predicted and checked, shifts and written cross-references are flagged.
assumptions: the scheme's levels are the example file NUMBERING SCHEME.docx's numbered styles PRT, ART, PR1, PR2, PR3 (level 0 first); a style this file lacks is imported with its list, a style it already has keeps this file's definition (existing keep)
the paragraphs converted are those of the list numbering the most paragraphs, each at its own level
the paragraphs' own indents and fonts stay (direct formatting kept)
numbers that shift, cross-reference fields and written references to old numbers are flagged, never edited
a whole-document change is plain formatting (decision 14.1)
